edits.new: Which topic, if either, strictly contains the other? A contains B when discussing B is necessarily discussing A; apply the same test in reverse. Mere association or partial overlap is not enough.
edits.old: Are those two topics the same? Answer yes only if those topics are equivalent; different wording and examples need not make them different. Answer no if the topics differ, including when one is broader or narrower than the other. Answer uncertain if the masks do not establish whether the topics are equivalent.

edits.new:
"a_parent": "A contains B, but B does not contain A",
        "b_parent": "B contains A, but A does not contain B",
        "neither": "Neither topic contains the other, or the topics are equivalent",
edits.old:
"yes": "The groups express the same topic at the same level of generality",
        "no": "The groups express different topics or different levels of generality",
